title: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
author: Xiaofeng Zhang
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Generate scRNA‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: Use the 10x Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' Reagent Kit (v3) and follow the manufacturer's protocol (ChromiumNextGEMSingleCell3_v3.1_Rev_D) to construct single‑cell RNA‑seq libraries from HCC tumor tissues derived from PDX.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the prepared libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform and run paired‑end 150 bp sequencing.

steps.title: Preprocess raw reads
steps.instruction: Process the raw sequencing reads with Cell Ranger software version 6.1.2, using the reference dataset “refdata‑gex‑GRCh38‑and‑mm10‑2020‑A”.

steps.title: Filter mouse‑oriented data
steps.instruction: Remove cells and genes identified as mouse‑oriented from the processed dataset.
